apiVersion: elderlygate/designer/design/v2
kind: Block
metadata:
  id: CMP-LOCKS
  title: The lock controller
spec:
  place:
    group: GRP-CORE
    role: handler
  state:
    status: open
  code:
    service: locker.locks
    implements: internal/locks/controller.go#Controller
  description: |
    Opens one door at a time and refuses to open a second while the first is
    still ajar.

    The refusal is the interesting half. A door that will not open is a
    complaint somebody makes; a bank of doors all open at once is a story in
    the local paper.
